plainTranslation: Their Sun in your 9th house: they expand your world: beliefs, travel, learning, the bigger picture. You grow around them. Failure mode: putting them on a teacher's pedestal. Let them broaden you; stay a peer.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
